# MiniModel.org Public Agent Context

MiniModel.org publishes bounded catalog and discovery metadata for TinyRustLM
models. Model bytes move only between consenting peers or remain local. Project
servers do not store, proxy, convert, execute, or repair model artifacts.

The browser catalog validates its catalog envelope, per-entry identity,
checksum-bound peer-offer metadata, announcement-feed identity, duplicate
model/peer constraints, and current signed outside-network proof requirements.
An empty announcement feed is valid metadata but does not make any model
available. A runtime fixture is not a quality-qualified product model.

The Rust verifier and CLI source live in this repository, while public site
deployment contains only HTML, CSS, JavaScript, documentation, examples, and
metadata. The deployment closure explicitly excludes `.slm` files, build
outputs, private `.uai` state, workspace memory, handoffs, and credentials.

Current site release: 1.0.0, released and last published 2026-08-09.
Release history: /updates/
Machine-readable release records: /.well-known/site-release.json and
/.well-known/site-release-history.json

Primary contracts:

- /catalog/models.v0.json
- /catalog/peer-source-announcements.v0.json
- /docs/catalog-boundary.md
- /docs/peer-companion.md
- /examples/tiny-test-model-q8.minimodel.manifest.v0
- /examples/tiny-test-model-q8.minimodel-peer-offer
- /examples/tiny-test-model-q8.minimodel-peer-import-request.json

Do not claim P2P availability without current outside-network proof. Do not
claim model quality from structural validation. Do not treat local probes,
fixtures, aliases, relabeled bytes, expired proof, or empty feeds as campaign
completion.
